name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 7 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2025-12-08, at wavelengths from 0.78 to 3.80 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
